The '''Peroenians''' were a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Peroenia]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. They had six digits on each of their hands and feet, and they also had long, yellow-and-gray-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The Peroenians were keen [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] and after they learned that the rival [[Shorak]] species had discovered the planet of [[Giaca]], the Peroenians dispatched a number of expeditions to Giaca. The Shorak eventually attempted to establish a permanent colony on Giaca and the Peroenians sent a military force to ambush the colonists in the [[Giaca system/Legends|Giaca system]], sparking a three-hundred-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long war between the two species in which the Shorak were eventually victorious.<ref name="TUR" />

Thousands of years later, about two decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Shorak re-established a [[Station 3Z3|settlement]] on Giaca and in response, the Peroenians dispatched representatives of their own to establish a presence on the world. While a number of skirmishes broke out on Giaca between the two species, the Shorak were eventually able to establish a permanent colony on the planet. However, the Peroenians continued to harry them and they frequently launched attacks on the Shorak colony.<ref name="TUR" />
